digital_arrest.description: Scammers impersonate police or CBI, claiming the user is under 'digital arrest' and demanding money to settle a fake case.

kyc_scam.description: Scammers claim bank KYC is expiring and ask user to transfer money to a 'security' account or share screen.

lottery_scam.description: User is told they won a prize but must pay a 'processing fee' or 'GST' via UPI first.
